svg.text: THE CLOCK AND THE SIXTEEN TIMED EFFECTS (GEFFECTS, DS:5BA8)
step every flying item and missile
move the door that is opening or closing
food of each member drops by 1
jitter the drawn position of monsters
* the period of entries 2 to 5 is overwritten by each level file (LoadLevel): 15 to 35 ticks in the shipped levels; entries 3 and 5 are offset by half a period.
var: the period is the time to the member's earliest timer (RunCharEffects); the entry is disarmed when all ten slots are empty.
